name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited
remarksWeb: I) Significant Beneficial Owners: A) Dr. Reddy's Holdings Limited holds 24.83% of the equity share capital of the Company. B) The APS Trust holds 83.11% of the equity share capital in Dr. Reddys Holdings Limited. The remainder of the equity of Dr. Reddys Holdings Limited is held by Mr. G.V. Prasad, Mr. K. Satish Reddy and certain of their respective family members and Hindu Undivided Families (HUF).Mr. G.V. Prasad and Mr. K. Satish Reddy are the sole trustees of the APS Trust. C) Pursuant to Explanation III(iv) to Rule 2(h) of Companies (Significant Beneficial Owner) Rules, 2018, the trustees of APS Trust i.e. Mr. G V Prasad and Mr. K Satish Reddy are the Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO) of the Company. D) The details of holding/exercise of rights of the SBO in the Company, by virtue of shares is a sum of their direct holding in the Company and indirect holding in HUF and/as Trustees of APS Trust .    II) In compliance with SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/CFD/CMD/CIR/P/2017/128 dated December 19, 2017, the shareholding is consolidated on the basis of PAN.    III) There is no option of LLP in the drop down list. Hence we have selected partnership firm as the category for VSD Holdings & Advisory LLP, being the most relevant option for this entity.
